dedupe_keys.name: sdn tcp syn testbed packet captures and network flow features

description: This deposit contains network-packet captures and flow features from a software-defined networking testbed. The research collaborators use a Mininet tree topology with four hosts and a Ryu controller, recording both browser activity and deliberately generated SYN-flood traffic. The repository describes 6,234 rows and eighty-four columns derived with CICFlowMeter. Mendeley version 2 lists two PCAP files and one CSV, free under CC BY 4.0. The article locates the work in Katra, India, but exact collection dates and a standard observation interval are not established. Coverage is limited to a small emulated topology and selected traffic, not production data-centre demand or actual incident rates. A reviewer-assessed use is evaluating defensive flow classification and congestion assumptions in network simulations. platform-mininet is the documented testbed environment. No packet payload, traffic-generation script or classifier was downloaded or executed, and direct replay compatibility was not tested.
name: SDN TCP SYN testbed packet captures and network-flow features
